ops.spec: Creates a Project with the given name. The new Project holds no Tasks. The name is not required to be unique — two Projects may share a name and remain distinct.
Creates a Task inside the given Project. The new Task is not done. Supplying a recurrenceRule creates a RecurringTask instead of a plain Task; omitting it creates a plain Task.

tests: a newly created Project holds no Tasks
a newly created Task is not done
creating two Projects with the same name yields two distinct Projects
createTask with a recurrenceRule yields a RecurringTask; without one it yields a plain Task
